scanNote:
WORKBOOK 35-BET. Unit 8 — buyurtma dialogi va e'londagi xatolarni topish.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 13-mashq (3 dialog), 14-mashq (10 bo'shliq), 15-mashq (10 xato), 16-mashq (radio e'loni namunasi).

⚠ 15-MAShQ — POSTERDAGI O'N XATO (radio matni bilan solishtirib topiladi):
  SEAFOOD → FAST FOOD (kitobda berilgan)
  MONDAY-FRIDAY → EVERY DAY (kitobda berilgan)
  Compton Street → BAKER STREET
  Spaghetti → PIZZAS
  Toasted Rolls → TOASTED SANDWICHES
  Fresh Cream → ICE-CREAM
  Classical Music! → ROCK MUSIC!
  Friendly People! → FRIENDLY SERVICE!
  Lots of prices! → LOW PRICES!
  OPEN 8 AM - 11 PM → OPEN 10 AM - 10 PM
  ⚠ 'Hamburgers' va 'Milkshakes' TO'G'RI — ular ikkala manbada ham bor, tuzatilmaydi.
  ⚠ 'Lots of prices' — ma'nosiz ibora; radio matnida 'LOW prices' (arzon narxlar). Bir harf farq qiladi, lekin ma'no butunlay boshqa.

⚠ 14-MAShQ — 10 BO'ShLIQ, 8 SO'Z: ba'zilari takrorlanadi (some x2, would x2, can x2, are x2, much, many).
  ⚠ 5-6 va 9-10-bandda IKKI so'z ketma-ket keladi: 'How MUCH ARE they?' va 'How MANY WOULD you like?'
  ⚠ 'sandwiches' va 'bananas' sanaladi → HOW MANY; narx so'ralganda → HOW MUCH ARE.

⚠ 13-MAShQ — O'LChOV BIRIKMALARI: a cup of tea · a packet of crisps · a glass of milk · a piece of cake · a cup of coffee · a sandwich (o'lchovsiz, chunki sanaladi).

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue between Tom and Kevin, then use the prompts below to make similar dialogues with Bill, Tamzin and Elaine.
exercises.instructionUz: Tom va Kevin o'rtasidagi dialogni o'qing, so'ng quyidagi so'zlar bilan Bill, Tamzin va Eleyn uchun shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI DIALOG:

  Tom:   Would you like a drink, Kevin?
  Kevin: Yes, please.
  Tom:   What would you like?
  Kevin: I'd like a glass of Coke.
  Tom:   Would you like something to eat?
  Kevin: Yes, please. Can I have some biscuits?
  Tom:   Yes, of course.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Tom:   Ichimlik xohlaysanmi, Kevin?
  Kevin: Ha, iltimos.
  Tom:   Nima xohlaysan?
  Kevin: Bir stakan kola olsam.
  Tom:   Yegani bir narsa xohlaysanmi?
  Kevin: Ha, iltimos. Pechenye olsam bo'ladimi?
  Tom:   Ha, albatta.

DIALOG TUZILISHI:
  1) Ichimlik taklif qilish → Would you like a drink?
  2) Qabul qilish → Yes, please.
  3) Nima xohlashini so'rash → What would you like?
  4) Buyurtma → I'd like ...
  5) Ovqat taklif qilish → Would you like something to eat?
  6) So'rash → Can I have ...?
  7) Rozilik → Yes, of course.

BERILGAN SO'ZLAR:
  Bill   — a cup of tea, a packet of crisps
  Tamzin — a glass of milk, a piece of cake
  Elaine — a cup of coffee, a sandwich

DIQQAT — MIQDOR IBORALARI:
  a cup of tea/coffee (issiq ichimlik)
  a glass of Coke/milk (sovuq ichimlik)
  a packet of crisps (quruq gazak)
  a piece of cake (kesilgan bo'lak)
  a sandwich (sanaladigan — miqdor so'zi kerak emas)

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the dialogue with words from the list. Then, in pairs, read the dialogue aloud.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan to'ldiring. So'ng juftlikda dialogni ovoz chiqarib o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: some, any, would, much, many, can, is, are

DIALOG (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A: Excuse me — What kind of sandwiches have you got?
  B: We've got SOME ham, cheese, tuna and tomato.
     Which WOULD you like?
  A: CAN I have three ham sandwiches please?
  B: Of course. Here you ARE.
  A: Thank you. How MUCH ARE they?
  B: They're £3.60, please. Anything else?
  A: Oh, yes — CAN I have SOME bananas, please?
  B: Sure. How MANY WOULD you like?

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  A: Kechirasiz — Sizda qanday buterbrodlar bor?
  B: Bizda vetchinali, pishloqli, tunetsli va pomidorli bor.
     Qaysinisini xohlaysiz?
  A: Uchta vetchinali buterbrod olsam bo'ladimi?
  B: Albatta. Mana, oling.
  A: Rahmat. Ular qancha turadi?
  B: 3 funt 60 pens, iltimos. Yana biror narsa kerakmi?
  A: Ha — banan olsam bo'ladimi?
  B: Albatta. Nechta xohlaysiz?

DIQQAT — 'HOW MUCH ARE THEY?':
  Narx uchun HOW MUCH, lekin ot ko'plikda → ARE.

DIQQAT — 'HERE YOU ARE':
  Narsani uzatganda aytiladigan o'zgarmas ibora.

YANGI SO'Z: tuna = tunets (baliq)

lines.textEn: Excuse me — What kind of sandwiches have you got?
We've got 1) ............ ham, cheese, tuna and tomato.
lines.whyUz:
TASDIQ gap ('We've got') → SOME.
'ham', 'cheese', 'tuna' — sanalmaydigan otlar.

'Which WOULD you like?' = qaysinisini xohlaysiz?
'Which do you like?' — umumiy yoqtirish savoli bo'lardi.

lines.textEn: 3) ............ I have three ham sandwiches please?

lines.whyUz:
'Here you ARE.' = Mana, oling.
O'zgarmas ibora — Coursebook 53 va 58-betlarda ham bor edi.

NARX → HOW MUCH.
'they' (sandwiches — ko'plik) → ARE.
'How MUCH ARE they?' = ular qancha turadi?

lines.textEn: Oh, yes — 7) ............ I have 8) ............ bananas, please?
lines.hintUz: ILTIMOS so'rash + iltimos savolida qaysi so'z?
lines.whyUz:
'CAN I have ...?' — ILTIMOS.
ILTIMOS savolida SOME ('any' emas).

'bananas' — SANALADIGAN → HOW MANY.
'WOULD you like?' — muloyim shakl.
5-band bilan solishtiring: sandwiches narxi → much; bananas soni → many.

sections.title: Reading — a radio advertisement and a poster

exercises.instructionEn: Read this text from a radio advertisement.
exercises.explanationUz:
RADIO REKLAMASI — 'THE WILD WEST' RESTORANI.

TUZILISHI (to'rt qism):
  1) Taklif + restoran turi va joyi
  2) Taomlar
  3) Muhit (musiqa, xizmat, narx)
  4) Ish vaqti + yakuniy chaqiriq

Bu tuzilish 16-mashqdagi yozma ish uchun NAMUNA bo'ladi.

sentences.en: Come to The Wild West, the all-new fast food restaurant on Baker Street!
sentences.uz: 'The Wild West' ga keling — Beyker ko'chasidagi mutlaqo yangi tez ovqat restorani!
sentences.noteUz:
'all-new' = mutlaqo yangi (reklama so'zi).
'fast food restaurant' = tez ovqat restorani.
Ko'cha nomi oldida ON.

sentences.en: The meals are wonderful, with lots of tasty dishes to choose from.
sentences.uz: Taomlar ajoyib, tanlash uchun ko'p mazali taomlar bor.

sentences.en: Try our hamburgers, pizzas and toasted sandwiches — and don't miss our special ice-cream and milkshakes!
sentences.uz: Gamburger, pitsa va qovurilgan buterbrodlarimizni tatib ko'ring — maxsus muzqaymoq va milkshaklarimizni ham qo'ldan boy bermang!
sentences.noteUz:
'toasted' = qovurilgan (nonushta noni kabi).
'a milkshake' = milksheyk (sut kokteyli).
'don't miss' — Coursebook 55-betdagi reklama iborasi.

sentences.en: Bring your friends, and enjoy our rock music, friendly service and low prices.
sentences.uz: Do'stlaringizni olib keling va rok musiqamiz, do'stona xizmatimiz hamda past narxlarimizdan zavqlaning.
sentences.noteUz:
'bring' = olib kelmoq.
'low prices' = past narxlar (aksi: high prices).
'friendly service' = do'stona xizmat.

sentences.en: We're open from 10 am to 10 pm every day.
sentences.uz: Biz har kuni ertalab soat 10 dan kechqurun soat 10 gacha ochiqmiz.
sentences.noteUz:
'from ... to ...' = ...dan ...gacha.
'every day' = har kuni (dam olish kunlari ham).

sentences.en: Come to The Wild West — it's great!
sentences.uz: 'The Wild West' ga keling — u zo'r!
sentences.noteUz:
Yakuniy chaqiriq — boshlanish takrorlanadi.
Reklamaning odatiy usuli.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the poster advertising the same restaurant. Find the mistakes in the poster and correct them, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Xuddi shu restoranni reklama qiladigan plakatga qarang. Plakatdagi xatolarni toping va to'g'rilang, namunalardagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
PLAKAT (THE WILD WEST) va RADIO MATNINI SOLIShTIRING.

PLAKATDAGI YOZUVLAR:
  SEAFOOD RESTAURANT  (chizib tashlangan → fast food)
  29, COMPTON STREET
  WONDERFUL MEALS! HOT FOOD!
  ☆ Hamburgers  ☆ Spaghetti
  ☆ Toasted Rolls
  ☆ Fresh Cream  ☆ Milkshakes
  Classical Music!
  Friendly People!
  Lots of prices!
  OPEN 8 AM – 11 PM, MONDAY-FRIDAY
     (MONDAY-FRIDAY chizib tashlangan → every day)

KITOBDA IKKITA NAMUNA BERILGAN:
  SEAFOOD → fast food
  MONDAY-FRIDAY → every day

Qolgan xatolarni radio matni bilan solishtirib toping.

items.whyUz:
Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
Radio matni: 'the all-new FAST FOOD restaurant'.
'seafood' = dengiz mahsulotlari — noto'g'ri.

Kitobda BERILGAN namuna.
Radio matni: 'open ... EVERY DAY' — faqat ish kunlari emas.

Radio matni: 'the fast food restaurant on BAKER STREET'.
Plakatda esa Compton Street yozilgan — XATO.
(Compton Street — 33-betdagi Luigi's restorani ko'chasi.)

Radio matni: 'our hamburgers, PIZZAS and toasted sandwiches'.
Plakatda 'Spaghetti' yozilgan — XATO.
'Hamburgers' esa TO'G'RI.

Radio matni: 'toasted SANDWICHES'.
Plakatda 'Toasted Rolls' (qovurilgan bulochkalar) — XATO.
'a roll' = kichik yumaloq non.

Radio matni: 'our special ICE-CREAM and milkshakes'.
Plakatda 'Fresh Cream' (yangi qaymoq) — XATO.
'Milkshakes' esa TO'G'RI.

Radio matni: 'enjoy our ROCK MUSIC'.
Plakatda 'Classical Music' (klassik musiqa) — XATO.

Radio matni: 'friendly SERVICE'.
Plakatda 'Friendly People' — XATO.
'service' = xizmat ko'rsatish.

Radio matni: 'LOW prices' = past narxlar.
Plakatda 'Lots of prices' (ko'p narxlar) — ma'nosiz, XATO.

Radio matni: 'open from 10 AM to 10 PM'.
Plakatda '8 am – 11 pm' — XATO.

sections.title: Writing — a radio advertisement for Spangles

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the newspaper advertisement for Spangles, and use the information to write a radio advertisement for the restaurant. Use the text from Ex. 15 as a model. Start each paragraph as shown below.
exercises.instructionUz: 'Spangles' uchun gazeta reklamasiga qarang va ma'lumotdan foydalanib restoran uchun radio reklamasini yozing. 15-mashqdagi matnni namuna qilib oling. Har bir xatboshini quyida ko'rsatilgandek boshlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
'SPANGLES' GAZETA REKLAMASIDAGI MA'LUMOT:

  Nomi:      Spangles
  Turi:      family restaurant (oilaviy restoran)
  Joyi:      104, Merrydale Road
  Shiori:    DELICIOUS FOOD - INTERESTING DISHES
  Taomlar:   Roast Beef, Vegetarian Meals, Home-made Soup,
             Chocolate Cake, Fresh Fruit Salad
  Muhit:     Live piano music, helpful waiters,
             friendly atmosphere
  Ish vaqti: OPEN 11 AM – 11 PM, MONDAY TO SATURDAY

KITOBDAGI XATBOShI BOShLANIShLARI:
  • Come to Spangles .....
  • The food is ....
  • Bring your children ....
  • We're open ....

15-MASHQDAGI NAMUNA MATN TUZILIShI:
  1-xatboshi: Come to X, the ... restaurant on ... Street!
  2-xatboshi: The ... is/are ... , with lots of ... to choose
              from. Try our ... — and don't miss our ...!
  3-xatboshi: Bring your ... , and enjoy our ... , ... and ...
  4-xatboshi: We're open from ... to ... , ... .
              Come to X — it's great!

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  roast beef = qovurilgan mol go'shti
  vegetarian = vegetarian (go'shtsiz)
  fresh fruit salad = yangi mevali salat
  live music = jonli musiqa
  atmosphere = muhit, kayfiyat

structure.modelEn: Come to Spangles, the family restaurant on Merrydale Road!
structure.noteUz:
15-mashqdagi qolip: 'Come to X, the ... restaurant on ... Street!'
Kitobda berilgan boshlanish: 'Come to Spangles .....'

structure.modelEn: The food is delicious, with lots of interesting dishes to choose from.
structure.noteUz:
Kitobda berilgan boshlanish: 'The food is ....'
Plakatdagi shior: 'DELICIOUS FOOD - INTERESTING DISHES'.

structure.modelEn: Try our roast beef, vegetarian meals and home-made soup — and don't miss our chocolate cake and fresh fruit salad!
structure.noteUz:
15-mashqdagi qolip: 'Try our ... — and don't miss our ...!'
Asosiy taomlar 'Try our' dan keyin, shirinliklar 'don't miss' dan keyin.

structure.modelEn: Bring your children, and enjoy our live piano music, helpful waiters and friendly atmosphere.
structure.noteUz:
Kitobda berilgan boshlanish: 'Bring your children ....'
DIQQAT: 'The Wild West' da 'Bring your FRIENDS' edi,
chunki u yoshlar uchun; 'Spangles' esa OILAVIY restoran →
'Bring your CHILDREN'.

structure.modelEn: We're open from 11 am to 11 pm, Monday to Saturday.
structure.noteUz:
Kitobda berilgan boshlanish: 'We're open ....'
DIQQAT: 'every day' EMAS — plakatda 'Monday to Saturday'
(yakshanba yopiq).

structure.modelEn: Come to Spangles, the family restaurant on Merrydale Road! The food is delicious, with lots of interesting dishes to choose from. Try our roast beef, vegetarian meals and home-made soup — and don't miss our chocolate cake and fresh fruit salad! Bring your children, and enjoy our live piano music, helpful waiters and friendly atmosphere. We're open from 11 am to 11 pm, Monday to Saturday. Come to Spangles — it's great!
structure.noteUz:
To'rt xatboshi, taxminan 75 so'z —
15-mashqdagi 'The Wild West' reklamasi bilan bir xil tuzilish.

groups.explanationUz: Reklamada BUYRUQ gaplar ko'p ishlatiladi — ular to'g'ridan-to'g'ri murojaat qiladi.

patterns.formula: Would you like a drink? — Yes, please. — What would you like? — I'd like ...
patterns.exampleEn: Would you like a drink, Kevin? — Yes, please. — What would you like? — I'd like a glass of Coke.
patterns.exampleUz: Ichimlik xohlaysanmi? — Ha, iltimos. — Nima xohlaysan? — Bir stakan kola olsam.

patterns.formula: How MUCH ARE they? — They're + narx.
patterns.explanationUz: Narx uchun HOW MUCH, lekin ot ko'plikda → ARE.

patterns.formula: Come to X, the + sifat + restaurant ON + ko'cha!
patterns.exampleEn: Come to Spangles, the family restaurant on Merrydale Road!
patterns.exampleUz: 'Spangles' ga keling — Merridale ko'chasidagi oilaviy restoran!
patterns.explanationUz: Reklamaning odatiy boshlanishi. Ko'cha nomi oldida ON.

patterns.formula: Try our ... — and DON'T MISS our ...!
patterns.exampleEn: Try our roast beef — and don't miss our chocolate cake!
patterns.exampleUz: Qovurilgan mol go'shtimizni tatib ko'ring — shokoladli tortimizni qo'ldan boy bermang!
patterns.explanationUz: Ikki buyruq gap bir gapda: taklif + ogohlantirish.

patterns.formula: Bring your ... , and ENJOY our ... , ... and ...
patterns.exampleEn: Bring your children, and enjoy our live piano music, helpful waiters and friendly atmosphere.
patterns.exampleUz: Bolalaringizni olib keling va jonli pianino musiqasi, yordamchan ofitsiantlar hamda do'stona muhitdan zavqlaning.

patterns.exampleEn: We're open from 11 am to 11 pm, Monday to Saturday.
patterns.exampleUz: Biz dushanbadan shanbagacha ertalab 11 dan kechqurun 11 gacha ochiqmiz.
patterns.explanationUz: 'from ... to ...' ikki marta: SOAT uchun va KUNLAR uchun.
